item.title: Rallying Cry – June 13, 2026
item.description: Today’s bright spots include the World Cup kicking off in the US with star-studded performances, the Knicks inching closer to an NBA title after 53 years, AI stepping up to protect EV chargers, and Ukraine’s EU membership talks resuming for a hopeful future.
